name: Corhazi Arsonist's Prepare ability grants stealth
notes: Corhazi Arsonist's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed. The starting champion is pre-seeded with 1 preparation counter directly (normally only reachable via a separate preparation-counter-granting effect) so the Prepare activated ability's cost (remove 1 preparation counter from your champion, resolved by the ActivatedAbilityCost() switch in GameLogic.php) can actually be paid. Only the always-available 'gain stealth' half is covered; the onHit 'banish instead of die' replacement requires a real combat hit and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Remove a preparation counter from your champion: CARDNAME gains stealth until end of turn.
